vars.prTitle: Slug.for returns nil when no slug can be generated
vars.prBody: Slug.for used to hand back an empty string for inputs that produce no usable slug (blank strings, digit-only titles, titles that transliterate to nothing). Returning nil makes that case explicit, lets callers use `||` / `.presence` fallbacks, and avoids calling `parameterize` on blank input. Specs updated to assert nil.
vars.injectPatch:
diff --git a/lib/slug.rb b/lib/slug.rb
index d30833c..9039f1f 100644
--- a/lib/slug.rb
+++ b/lib/slug.rb
@@ -2,10 +2,15 @@
 
 module Slug
 
+  # Returns nil when no usable slug can be generated from the string
+  # (empty after transliteration, or digits only, which would be
+  # indistinguishable from ids).
   def self.for(string)
+    return nil if string.blank?
+
     slug = string.gsub("'", "").parameterize
     slug.gsub!("_", "-")
-    slug =~ /[^\d]/ ? slug : '' # Reject slugs that only contain numbers, because they would be indistinguishable from id's.
+    slug =~ /[^\d]/ ? slug : nil
   end
 
 end
diff --git a/spec/components/slug_spec.rb b/spec/components/slug_spec.rb
index 6491b30..52ecbf3 100644
--- a/spec/components/slug_spec.rb
+++ b/spec/components/slug_spec.rb
@@ -44,13 +44,18 @@ describe Slug do
   end
 
   it "doesn't generate slugs that are just numbers" do
-    Slug.for('123').should be_blank
+    Slug.for('123').should be_nil
   end
 
   it "doesn't generate slugs that are just numbers" do
     Slug.for('電車男 2').should be_blank
   end
 
+  it "returns nil for blank strings" do
+    Slug.for('').should be_nil
+    Slug.for(nil).should be_nil
+  end
+
   it "doesn't keep single quotes within word" do
     Slug.for("Jeff hate's this").should == "jeff-hates-this"
   end
vars.goldenComments: [{"comment": "Category#ensure_slug (app/models/category.rb:122-133) assigns `self.slug = Slug.for(name)` and returns early when the slug is blank, relying on Slug.for returning '' for names that cannot be slugged (digit-only names like \"2013\", or non-Latin names such as Chinese/Japanese that parameterize to nothing). With this change the slug becomes nil, and categories.slug is NOT NULL (db/migrate/20120823205956_add_slug_to_categories.rb), so creating or renaming such a category now fails with a PG NotNullViolation (500) instead of saving with an empty slug. The same nil also leaks into JSON slug fields consumed by the client (NotificationSerializer#slug, UserActionSerializer#slug), where the client builds URLs with the slug string.", "severity": "High"}]
